title: Bayern managers in order
brief: Name Bayern Munich's last ten permanent head coaches, labelled by the year each spell began. A manager with two spells fills two places.
period: Permanent head coach spells starting 2009 to 2024 (the ten most recent; spells since 2000 run to 13)

notes.Jurgen Klinsmann: Klinsmann (Jul 2008 to Apr 2009) is the 11th most recent spell, just before this board starts.
notes.Ottmar Hitzfeld: Hitzfeld's second spell (Feb 2007 to Jun 2008) and first (1998 to 2004) are before this board starts.
notes.Felix Magath: Magath (Jul 2004 to Jan 2007) is before this board starts.
notes.Andries Jonker: Jonker was caretaker in 2011, so he is not counted.
notes.Willy Sagnol: Sagnol was caretaker for one game in 2017, so he is not counted.
notes.Hansi Flick: Flick took over as caretaker in November 2019 and was then made permanent; it is one spell.

checks: Spells and start dates from Transfermarkt's head coach history match German Wikipedia's list of Bayern coaches since 1963, which marks Heynckes (2009), Jonker (2011) and Sagnol (2017) as interim; those caretaker spells are left out. Heynckes fills two places (2011 and 2017).
